checks.name: Backend verify incl. ModerationIntegrationTest and identity step-up (PostgreSQL, Keycloak)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity
Cook and staff browser workflow against the real local stack (Playwright, Chromium)

scenario_results.observed: ModerationIntegrationTest: hiding a published meal (content.moderate; cook and cook.review 403; reason required 422; stale version 409; repeat 409) removes it from discovery, public detail (404) and quotes; the cook's content and status are unchanged, the cook sees HIDDEN with the reason, and pause/republish does not lift it; the catalogue lists it without private kitchen data; restore makes it discoverable and orderable again; two audit events. Suspension (cook.review with MFA) reports activeOrders PENDING_ACCEPTANCE 1 and removes the kitchen's meals from discovery, detail and checkout; restore re-enables them. Identity: stepUp=true sends acr_values and max_age=0 with PKCE. Browser workflow (scripts/dev.sh e2e): ops-a without grants sees no staff sections; with synthetic content.moderate and cook.review grants sees reviews and catalogue but not cook tabs; hides the meal (public detail 404, customer quote refused) and restores it (detail 200); opens the approved application with private location and the kitchen panel with impact; a suspension attempt without MFA shows the step-up link (stepUp=true) and the kitchen stays ACTIVE; the cook gets 403 on the catalogue. Operations web component tests: reviewer queue, signed document link, decision body and step-up prompt; moderation needs a reason. Private documents: never in public responses (MediaIntegrationTest/CookWorkflowIntegrationTest within backend verify). Approval reflection: no kitchen means no workspace and no selling (cook workflow tests, browser onboarding state). Mutations dropping the discovery or quote filter failed the tests.

findings: Moderation enforced in discovery, detail and quotes; mutations detected.
Impact summary via cooks.api port implemented by orders (acyclic modules).
